title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 on B200, vLLM v0.31: TP=4 aggregated (4 GPUs) and 1P1D disaggregated (8 GPUs); no-router vs llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified vs turn-priority, with 387 GiB CPU offload per server
description: Step 26. One vLLM pod per point (4 B200, TP=4, MTP 3, FP8 KV, GPU KV 4.74M to 4.84M tokens, max-num-seqs 2x concurrency), AgentX replay of the Weka Claude Code trace, 60 min per point, KV cache reset per point. CPU tier 387 GiB = 12.68M tokens (measured: 5,959 chunks of one 2128-token attention block; Qwen3.5 keeps KV in 15 of 60 layers). llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified (llm-d-router main): capacity = the server's vLLM kv_cache_size_tokens, lease 10 s, forced admission 1800 s.  Step 30 adds llm-d-router v1.0.0 turn-priority (3 points). Step 33 adds 1P1D prefill/decode disaggregation (5 points, c=32 to 128): one prefill and one decode server, TP=4 each on one 8x B200 node, KV over NIXL/RDMA, MultiConnector NIXL + 387 GiB CPU offload on each server (CPU tier 2 x 12.68M tokens), vllm-project/vllm#62862 fix on, vLLM's NIXL toy proxy (every request P then D), no router. Per-GPU metrics divide by 8 GPUs; compare at equal concurrency per GPU (1P1D c=64 against TP=4 c=32).

router.config:
# llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified for step 26, lane qb (qwen35-tp4-b): capacity 4843063 tokens, the
# kv_cache_size_tokens vLLM reports for that server. vLLM's hybrid (Gated DeltaNet + attention) KV cache
# uses 2128-token blocks, and block_size x num_gpu_blocks would overstate the token capacity by about
# 13%, so the engine config below drops cacheInfoSpec and the gate uses capacityTokens. Idle lease 10 s,
# forced admission after 1800 s. EPP image: upstream main, ghcr.io/llm-d/llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:main
# pinned to sha256:c0d60804... (commit 907c5fe8). Endpoints from a file (file-discovery, no RBAC on a4-pr).
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
featureGates:
- flowControl
plugins:
- name: vllm-endpoints
  type: file-discovery
  parameters:
    path: /config/endpoints.yaml
    watchFile: true
- type: metrics-data-source
  parameters:
    scheme: http
    path: /metrics
- type: core-metrics-extractor
  parameters:
    defaultEngine: vllm-no-cacheinfo
    engineConfigs:
    - name: vllm-no-cacheinfo
      queuedRequestsSpec: vllm:num_requests_waiting
      runningRequestsSpec: vllm:num_requests_running
      kvUsageSpec: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc
      loraSpec: vllm:lora_requests_info
- type: agent-identity
  parameters:
    additionalSessionHeaders:
    - x-session-id
- type: thunder-agent
  name: thunder
  parameters:
    capacityTokens: 4843063
    utilThreshold: 1.0
    idleLeaseSeconds: 10
    headWaitStarvationMs: 1800000
    evictionTtlSeconds: 3600
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
flowControl:
  defaultRequestTTL: "0s"
  saturationDetector:
    pluginRef: thunder
  defaultPriorityBand:
    fairnessPolicyRef: thunder
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: thunder
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
dataLayer:
  sources:
  - pluginRef: metrics-data-source
    extractors:
    - pluginRef: core-metrics-extractor
  discovery:
    endpoints:
      pluginRef: vllm-endpoints
